meta.title: Velora — Pleated Blinds & Insect Screens
meta.description: Insect screen and pleated blind systems manufactured in Turkey. Information for trade dealers across Europe.

home.hero_eyebrow: Made in Turkey, delivered across Europe
home.hero_title: One folding system, one uninterrupted flow of air.
home.hero_subtitle: We manufacture insect screen and pleated blind systems in our own workshop and supply trade dealers across Europe.
home.intro_text: This site is not a sales platform. It's here to introduce our products, our manufacturing process and our company to trade dealers across Europe. Orders and pricing are handled directly through personal contact.

highlights.title: Made in our own workshop
highlights.text: Cutting, assembly and final inspection all take place in-house — we don't outsource production to third parties.

highlights.title: Delivery across Europe
highlights.text: We ship regularly and traceably to our dealers, with options for consolidated pallet shipments.

highlights.title: Technical support for dealers
highlights.text: We provide our dealers with technical documentation and direct support on measuring, installation and product selection.

home.products_teaser_text: From insect screen systems to pleated blinds — a wide range suited to different mounting types.
home.cta_text: Contact us for product information, sample requests or dealer terms.

products.title: Products
products.intro: All our products are made to order and to measure, in our own workshop. The details below cover general product features; contact us for technical drawings and sample requests.

items.name: Pleated Insect Screen
items.description: Accordion-folded insect screen for doors and windows, moving horizontally or vertically and retracting into its cassette when not in use.
specs: Suited to hinged and sliding doors

items.name: Sliding Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen that slides horizontally along a track, suited to wide door and balcony openings.
specs: Available as single or double panel

items.name: Hinged Insect Screen
items.description: Classic single-panel insect screen that opens and closes like a door.
specs: Fits standard window and door sizes

items.name: Magnetic Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen fitted with a magnetic closure strip, easy to attach and remove.
specs: Suited to rentals and simple installation

items.name: Roller Insect Screen
items.description: Insect screen that retracts into a small cassette when not in use, moving horizontally or vertically.
specs: Suited to window and door applications

items.name: Single Pleated Blind
items.description: Single-layer pleated fabric blind for windows, moving up or down.
specs: Wide range of fabrics and colours

items.name: Duo (Day & Night) Pleated Blind
items.description: Two-layer pleated blind combining a sheer and a blackout fabric for flexible light control.

items.name: Pleated Blind for Folding Glass Walls
items.description: Pleated blind solution fitted to folding glass wall systems using dedicated mounting hardware.
specs: Dedicated hardware for folding glass wall profiles

workshop.title: Workshop & Manufacturing
workshop.intro: All our products are made in our own workshop. From cutting to assembly, every step is handled by our own team.

steps.title: Profile cutting
steps.text: Aluminium profiles are cut precisely to order dimensions at our cutting stations.

steps.title: Joining & assembly
steps.text: Cut pieces are corner-joined and assembled into a complete frame.

steps.title: Fitting the fabric or mesh
steps.text: Pleated fabric or insect mesh is tensioned into the cassette using dedicated machinery.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.text: Every product is checked before shipping for smooth mechanism operation and surface quality.

steps.title: Packing & shipping
steps.text: Products are packed to withstand transport and prepared for shipment.

workshop.gallery_note: Workshop photos will be added to this section shortly.

about.title: About Us
intro_paragraphs: Velora is a Turkish manufacturer specialising in insect screen and pleated blind systems.
We manufacture exclusively in our own workshop — cutting, assembly, quality control and packing are all handled by our own team.
Through regular deliveries to trade dealers across Europe, we make sure our products reach the end customer reliably.

values.title: In-house manufacturing
values.text: We rely on controlled processes in our own workshop rather than third-party contract manufacturing.

values.title: Dealer relationships
values.text: We build long-term, trust-based business relationships with our dealers.

values.title: Material quality
values.text: We prioritise durability in the aluminium profiles and fabrics we choose.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: For dealer terms, sample requests or questions about our products, feel free to get in touch.
